summary.text: Gina Thomas-Littlejohn is the Democratic candidate for Arkansas House of Representatives District 81 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent RJ Hawk.
A business manager born in Brinkley, Arkansas, she lost to Hawk in the 2024 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gina Thomas-Littlejohn was born in Brinkley, Arkansas, and lists her profession as business manager.
She was the Democratic nominee for District 81 in 2024, when Hawk defeated her, 60.2 percent to 39.8 percent.
In the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary she defeated Elijah Thompson with 63.7 percent of the vote.
